conditional_bound_review.conclusion: Valid only under all stated conditions; not measured hardware utilization and not a universal architecture limit.
conditions: Every counted software Add0, Mul1 and MulIeeeRne6 request maps one-to-one to a successful transaction on one unchanged shared BlockScalarFloat.
No elimination, fusion, vectorization, batching or replicated scalar service reduces the request demand on that single FSM.
The compared window includes elapsed time from its first counted scalar request through its last counted scalar result.
The denominator uses a nominal 4096 MAC slots in every window cycle; this is an assumed metric capacity, not a measured issue rate.
The numerator counts all rectangular QK/PV positions, including causal zero-coefficient terms, making the useful-work ceiling optimistic.
conditional_bound_review.scope_limit: Torch-specific reduction/QK software policy wiring and full coordinator scheduling have not been proved on production Chisel/RTL.

source_evidence.claim: Only idle accepts. Successful basic operations follow idle to normal to done to idle; earliest successive requests are 3 cycles apart.
Add/Mul increment public calls exactly once.
MulIeeeRne increments public calls exactly once.
Compound exp internal nodes use a separate counter; they are not counted in N.
